items.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez are married
items.summary: The Portugal star tied the knot with Rodríguez in an 'intimate and private' civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, attended by their five children — a year after their engagement. Ronaldo announced it with a photo of their wedding bands.

items.headline: Alessandra Ambrosio engaged to Buck Palmer
items.summary: The supermodel announced her engagement to the Australian jewelry designer after nearly two years of dating — a beach proposal inside a heart made of flowers in the sand.

items.headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day hits $1.67B in 10 days, shattering records
items.summary: Sony/Marvel's film (Tom Holland's fourth outing, directed by Destin Daniel Cretton) is already the 12th highest-grossing movie ever: $655.1M domestic — the most any movie has made in 10 days — plus $1.01B overseas, the second-fastest to $1B internationally after Avengers: Endgame. Its $144.5M second weekend is the third-biggest ever, and $2B worldwide is within reach.

items.headline: The Odyssey becomes Christopher Nolan's highest-grossing film ever
items.summary: Nolan's Homeric epic crossed $1.1B worldwide ($461M domestic) in four weekends, passing The Dark Knight Rises. It's also IMAX's highest-grossing domestic release of all time ($147.3M), the second-highest-grossing R-rated movie ever, and the biggest global hit of Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway and Robert Pattinson's careers.

items.headline: Aubrey Plaza welcomes first child with Christopher Abbott
items.summary: The Parks and Recreation and White Lotus actress was spotted with a newborn at Abbott's final Broadway performance of Death of a Salesman in New York. The couple confirmed the pregnancy in April.

items.headline: Tallulah Willis marries Justin Acee in Idaho ceremony
items.summary: The youngest daughter of Bruce Willis and Demi Moore wed the musician in Sun Valley, wearing a custom Balenciaga gown by Pierpaolo Piccioli — one of the first bridal looks he's designed for the house. Demi and sisters Rumer and Scout were on hand.

items.headline: Summer box office passes $4B domestic — best since 2019
items.summary: Powered by Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey crossing $1B on the same weekend, the domestic summer haul hit $3.985B+ (up 4.4% on 2019's pace) with year-to-date ticket sales at $6.6B, up 18.5% over last year.

items.headline: Toy Story 5 becomes Pixar's third-highest-grossing film ever
items.summary: With $1.094B worldwide ($470M domestic), the sequel passed Toy Story 3 and Toy Story 4 to become the franchise's biggest film and the No. 8 animated theatrical release ever.

items.headline: The End of Oak Street opens — Hathaway's fourth film of 2026
items.summary: Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor star in the small-town sci-fi survival film directed by David Robert Mitchell (It Follows). It's Hathaway's fourth of five planned 2026 releases, ahead of the Colleen Hoover adaptation Verity.

items.headline: Jon Hamm and Anna Osceola expecting their first baby
items.summary: The Mad Men star and his wife are expecting their first child together.

items.headline: Jamie Foxx preparing for his third child
items.summary: Foxx is set to become a father again, with his third child on the way.
